title: Loi du 7 octobre 2022 / wet van 7 oktober 2022, arts. 4 to 7: information on the employment relationship
source: Loi du 7 octobre 2022 transposant partiellement la directive (UE) 2019/1152 (Moniteur belge 31 October 2022, numac 2022206298, in force 10 November 2022), arts. 4 to 7, in French and Dutch; loi du 3 juillet 1978 relative aux contrats de travail arts. 15, 67 (repealed from 1 January 2014) and 127; decreet van 19 juli 1973 (Flemish Community) arts. 2 and 5; décret du 30 juin 1982 (French Community) arts. 1 and 2. Justel consolidated texts, read 2026-10-09.
note: A drafting check, not legal advice: the scripted rules read whether a particular is there, never whether a term is lawful.

rules.text: The items of art. 4 are given by the first working day; those of art. 5 within a month; work abroad before departure.
The parties, the place of work (or that it varies, with the employer's seat), the function, the start and a fixed term's end or expected length.
The pay: the starting amount, every other element separately, the extra-legal social security benefits, and how and how often it is paid.

A fixed schedule gives when the regular day starts and ends, the breaks and the regular days off, or the work rules' schedule; a variable one the principle, the hours, the daily window and the days, and how the schedule is announced.

Training, annual holidays, the termination procedure with the time to challenge a dismissal, the collective agreements with the joint committee, and the social security institution: each given, or said to be in the work rules. Art. 5 binds this document only for a worker outside the work rules act of 8 April 1965; for everyone else the work rules carry these items.

The pay, the hours, and art. 5's training, holidays and termination may point to a law, a regulation or a collective agreement, and art. 5's items to the work rules; the parties, place, function and dates are stated.
No trial period on an ordinary employment contract since 1 January 2014; student and agency contracts excepted.
rules.source: loi du 3 juillet 1978 art. 67 (repealed), art. 127; art. 4 § 2 7°

rules.text: Work abroad over four consecutive weeks: the country and length, the currency, the benefits and the return home.
The statement is in the language of the workplace's region: Dutch in Flanders, French in Wallonia, either in Brussels.
rules.source: decreet 19 juli 1973 art. 5; décret 30 juin 1982 art. 2

rules.text: Every heading is in the statement's language.
rules.source: decreet 19 juli 1973 art. 5; décret 30 juin 1982 art. 2
